methodology.title: How we assess
methodology.subtitle: Every score traces to a documented source.
methodology.intro: Rihal Aptitude measures behavioral fit for a role family — not job knowledge or general intelligence. Each competency traces to an O*NET work style or cited Big Five literature, and every result decomposes fit → competency → trait → source.
methodology.chain: Role family → O*NET work styles + Big Five trait literature → target competency profile. A candidate's IPIP-NEO-120 traits and situational-judgement responses are compared against that target to produce a fit score and community percentiles.
methodology.norms: Community percentiles use the Johnson IPIP-NEO research dataset (Western-skewed, 2001–2011). Fit-to-role does not depend on it; percentiles are a secondary reference. Local validity comes from the calibration loop over time.
